correctness.rationale: The original exact conditional PMF separates into t_{n,j}/2−1/[n(n+1)] plus (p−1/2)Δ_{n,j}; A_{n,n}=2/(n+1), t symmetric, Δ antisymmetric and equal to ∑_{k=j}^{n-j} t_{n,k} on the left. Two-sided Stirling gives n^(5/2)t_{n,j}->(2pi)^(-1/2)[x(1-x)]^(-3/2) in the bulk and a summable boundary majorant. The total n-scaled t mass concentrates as 1 at each endpoint; n^(3/2)Δ has explicit integrable bulk profile H=4(1−2x)/sqrt(2pi x(1−x)). This yields half-unit endpoint absolute masses and a signed bulk integral; sinusoidal integration produces the exact square-root profile. A global L1 bound on Δ handles the outer bias. Independently computed gamma-log exact-kernel numerical asymptotic diagnostics n=1000 and 10000: nTV at p=.5 ~0.803,0.906; at p=.5+1/sqrt n ~1.762,1.943 (slow boundary-layer convergence toward 2.172); sqrt(n)TV at p=1 ~0.762,0.786 toward sqrt(2/pi). Limits rely on analysis, not finite values.

It addresses a central natural statistic without claiming new finite parking enumeration.
